### Canadian Institute of Mining


Event Date : May 2, 2027 - May 5, 2027
Event Location : Montreal, Canada


Event Link :[https://www.cimconnect.ca/cim-connect-2027](https://www.cimconnect.ca/cim-connect-2027)


Twin Disc will be attending the Canadian Institute of Mining Convention this coming May, along with Kobelt and Katsa.
